# Copilot instructions — moved

All instructions for this repo are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root.

> **Read `AGENTS.md` instead of this file.**
> This file exists only so tools that look for `.github/copilot-instructions.md` can find the entry point. It has no rules of its own.

Key points, in case you cannot follow the link: this is a study playground for *Domain-Driven Refactoring*. `reference/` is read-only, code is written in `playground/kotlin/` (Kotlin, Kafka, Postgres); you write small examples, the owner only reads and runs them; never commit, tag or push unless asked.
